audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read 'Skill' while its own content why says Poppy cycles Steadfast Presence through every trade, and the 2+ item row read Poppy while both its why and its spike say Sylas outscales her.
audit.why: The packet chart and the mirror poppy__sylas both read Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Sylas. At 6 her W is on a 16s cooldown and blanks the only entry Sylas has; at two AP items his healing and slow beat a kit with no percent-health or true damage.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Poppy and 2+ items to Sylas in matched pairs, the 2+ rating raised, and phases[4].why rewritten so it stops promising the swing to Sylas.

audit.why: Four spikes and the right ones — her level 2-3 CC chain, her level 6 W uptime, her first armour item, and Sylas's two-item reclaim. Only the ability described inside spikes[0] was wrong.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rewritten around Hammer Shock's real behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields call Hammer Shock a knockup — 'Q poke vs Q knockup', 'wall-pin you into a Q knockup', 'Q knockup into auto-attack pattern'. The page also credits Steadfast Presence only with stopping Abscond, and four fields say Abduct stuns.
audit.why: Hammer Shock (Q, 430 range, 8/7/6/5/4s) deals damage and leaves a zone that slows and then explodes after a delay — there is no knockup anywhere in it. Poppy's only knockup is Keeper's Verdict. Steadfast Presence stops enemy dashes near her and slows and grounds whatever it catches, which means it stops Kingslayer as well as Abscond — a player who saves W as the escape from a blocked E finds both gone. Abduct is a chain pull with no stun.
audit.corrected: Hammer Shock described as the delayed detonation zone, the wall-pin stun credited to Heroic Charge alone, and Steadfast Presence stated as stopping both of Sylas's dashes.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d says a whiffed Steadfast Presence gives the lane to you 'briefly' without a number.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s — the longest single window in this matchup and the only time Sylas's mobility exists. That number is the whole matchup and it was nowhere on the page.

edits.before: Poppy's W is the matchup in a single button. At level 1 neither of you has a clean edge — trade Q slows for her Q knockup and stay off walls. The moment she hits level 2, however, she can E you into a wall for a stun into Q knockup, and that full pattern chunks hard before your W has any healing power. Respect the wall-pin range at all times: fight in the center of the lane, never near the side walls where Heroic Charge has an instant stun. Your Q slow is the only safe harass tool this early — poke with it and step back before she reaches you.
edits.after: Poppy's W is the matchup in a single button — it stops Abscond and Kingslayer both. At level 1 neither of you has a clean edge: trade Chain Lash slows against her Hammer Shock zone and stay off walls. The moment she hits level 2 she can E you into a wall for a stun and hold you there for the Hammer Shock detonation, and that pattern chunks hard before your W has any healing power. Respect the wall-pin range at all times: fight in the centre of the lane, never near the side walls where Heroic Charge stuns. Your Q slow is the only safe harass this early — poke and step back.
